description: This file defines an interface class IWebAudioPlayerService for web audio player services within the Rialto media server component. It declares virtual methods for creating, controlling, and querying web audio players, and includes necessary headers and namespace encapsulation.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerService
classes.description: An interface class providing virtual methods for managing web audio players, including creation, control, and information retrieval.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new web audio player with specified parameters such as handle, client, MIME type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys the web audio player identified by the handle.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of the web audio player identified by the handle.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback of the web audio player identified by the handle.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets the end-of-stream marker for the specified web audio player.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available buffer frames and shared memory info for the specified player.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the current buffer delay in frames for the specified player.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer of the specified player.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for the specified web audio player.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume level of the specified web audio player.
